session_8.text: Oh, Ethan, you know what, no-one is gonna be able to tell.

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: My mom will.

session_8.speaker: Dexter
session_8.text: Something so sweet and...disturbing about that.

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Y'know, I've done nothing but crappy plays for six years. And I finally get my shot, and I blow it!

session_8.speaker: Chloe
session_8.text: Maybe this wasn't your shot.

session_8.speaker: Bennett
session_8.text: Yeah, I mean... I think when it's your shot, y'know, you-you know it's your shot. Did it... feel like your shot..?

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Hard to tell, I was naked.

session_8.speaker: Fiona
session_8.text: No, I don't think this was your shot. I mean, I don't even think you just get one shot. I really believe big things are gonna happen for you, I do! You've gotta just keep thinking about the day that some kid is gonna run up to his friends and go 'I got the part! I got the part! I'm gonna be Ethan Tribbiani's ass!'.

session_8.speaker: Ethan
session_8.text: Yeah? That's so nice!

session_8.speaker: Chloe
session_8.text: I'm sorry, Ethan. I'm gonna go to bed, guys.

session_8.speaker: All
session_8.text: Night.

session_8.speaker: Ariel
session_8.text: Uh, Mon, you-you gonna leave your shoes out here?

session_8.speaker: Chloe
session_8.text: Uh-huh!

session_8.speaker: Ariel
session_8.text: Really? Just casually strewn about in that reckless haphazard manner?

session_8.speaker: Chloe
session_8.text: Doesn't matter, I'll get 'em tomorrow. Or not. Whenever.

session_8.speaker: Bennett
session_8.text: She is a kook.
